title: Shop — Traces
description: Distributed tracing analytics from the spans (LogsQL on VictoriaTraces): service map, endpoints, where the time goes inside a request, database and Redis calls, failures, hot spots by attribute and single traces.

list.name: attribute
list.label: Hot spots by
list.query: product : span_attr:order.product_id,user : span_attr:order.user_id,HTTP status : span_attr:http.response.status_code,pod : resource_attr:k8s.pod.name,node : resource_attr:k8s.node.name,version : resource_attr:service.version

query.query: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 (duration:>${min_duration:raw} or "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") | stats by (trace_id) max(duration) d, max("span_attr:http.response.status_code") code | sort by (d desc) | limit 30 | math round(d/1e6) as ms | format "<ms> ms · HTTP <code> · <trace_id>" as option

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, job, deployment, slo) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Shop.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Server spans per second: every request handled by the selected services (a checkout passes through several of them).

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats rate() rps

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of server spans answered with a 5xx.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats count() calls, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") failed | math failed*100/calls as pct_5xx | fields pct_5xx

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of the server spans.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: Slowest endpoint (p95)
panels.description: The endpoint with the highest p95; break it down in "Where the time goes".

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats by (name) quantile(0.95, duration) p95 | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 1

panels.title: Failed operations
panels.description: Spans with an error status in the time range, business outcomes excluded (4xx answers seen by a client, declined payments): timeouts, 5xx, database errors.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined | stats count() failed

panels.title: Declined payments
panels.description: Business outcome, not a failure: payments the provider declined.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) "span_attr:payment.status":=declined | stats count() declined

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Every service, PostgreSQL and Redis: requests per second in the circle, p95 and the failed share below the name. The ring shows the share of successful (green) and failed (red) spans, business outcomes not counted as failures. Hover an arrow for its calls per second, p95 and failed share. Click a node for its details.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop (kind:=2 or kind:=5 or (kind:=3 ("span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql or "span_attr:db.system":=redis) -name:="pool.acquire")) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as id | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql) "postgresql" as id | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system":=redis) "redis" as id | copy id as title | format if (id:=postgresql) "shop-db (PostgreSQL)" as title | format if (id:=redis) "Redis" as title | stats by (id, title) rate() rps, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, count() requests, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined) failed | math round(p95/1e6, 0.1) as p95_ms, round(failed*100/requests, 0.01) as failed_pct | format "p95 <p95_ms> ms · <failed_pct>% failed" as subtitle | stats by (id, title, subtitle) max(rps) mainstat, max(requests) detail__requests, max(failed) detail__failed | math (detail__requests-detail__failed)/detail__requests as arc__success, detail__failed/detail__requests as arc__errors

"resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop kind:=3 -name:="pool.acquire" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as source, "span_attr:server.address" as target | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql) "postgresql" as target | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system":=redis) "redis" as target | filter target:* | format "<source>→<target>" as id | stats by (id, source, target) rate() mainstat, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, count() detail__calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined) detail__failed | math round(p95/1e6, 0.1) as detail__p95_ms, round(detail__failed*100/detail__calls, 0.01) as detail__failed_pct | delete p95

panels.title: Calls to dependencies
panels.description: Client spans by caller and callee: other services, PostgreSQL (shop-db-rw) and Redis. p95 includes the network and the callee's work.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop kind:=3 -name:="pool.acquire" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:server.address" as peer | format if ("span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql) "shop-db (PostgreSQL)" as peer | format if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "Redis" as peer | filter peer:* | stats by (service, peer) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined) failed, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") e4, quantile(0.95, duration) p95 | sort by (calls desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Endpoints (server spans)
panels.description: Every endpoint of the selected services, slowest first. 4xx are client or business outcomes. Click an endpoint to break it down, a service to open its dashboard.

value.title: Break down this endpoint (Where the time goes)

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name) count() calls, rate() rps, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") e5, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") e4, quantile(0.5, duration) p50, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, quantile(0.99, duration) p99, max(duration) slowest | math round(e5*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_5xx, round(e4*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_4xx | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 100
"resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats by (name) quantile(0.95, duration) p95
"resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5" | stats by (name) count() failed

panels.title: Operations in $endpoint traces
panels.description: Every span of the traces that went through the selected endpoint, across all services, by total time. The share is the operation's time over the endpoint's own time; spans nest (a client call contains the server span it calls), so read it top-down rather than adding it up. Consumers such as notification.deliver run after the response.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:server.address" as peer, "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql, "span_attr:db.statement" as redis_stmt | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:http.request.method":*) "<name> → <peer>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | extract if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "<redis_cmd> " from redis_stmt | format if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "Redis <redis_cmd>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined) failed, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, sum(duration) total | total_stats max(total) root_total | math round(total*100/root_total, 0.1) as time_pct, total/calls as avg | sort by (total desc) | limit 40

panels.title: p95 by operation in $endpoint traces
panels.description: A step in one operation shows where a slowdown of the endpoint comes from.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:server.address" as peer, "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql, "span_attr:db.statement" as redis_stmt | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:http.request.method":*) "<name> → <peer>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | extract if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "<redis_cmd> " from redis_stmt | format if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "Redis <redis_cmd>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: Failed operations in $endpoint traces
panels.description: The operation that fails first is usually the cause; the spans above it fail because of it.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:server.address" as peer, "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql, "span_attr:db.statement" as redis_stmt | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (kind:=3 "span_attr:http.request.method":*) "<name> → <peer>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | extract if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "<redis_cmd> " from redis_stmt | format if ("span_attr:db.system":=redis) "Redis <redis_cmd>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) count() failed

panels.title: Database and Redis, as the services see them — $service
SQL statements
panels.description: Client-side duration of each statement: network, lock waits and server execution together. Compare with Top statements in the CloudNativePG dashboard (server side only): a gap means waiting outside PostgreSQL's execution, e.g. for locks.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) "span_attr:db.query.text":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | stats by (service, sql) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2) failed, quantile(0.5, duration) p50, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, max(duration) slowest, avg("span_attr:pgx.rows_affected") row_count | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Redis commands
panels.description: Redis commands by service (cache reads and writes, idempotency keys, the notification stream).

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) "span_attr:db.system":=redis | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | extract "<command> " from "span_attr:db.statement" | stats by (service, command) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2) failed, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, max(duration) slowest | sort by (calls desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Waiting for a connection vs SQL (p95)
panels.description: pool.acquire spans: time a request waited for a free connection of its service's pool. Waits close to the SQL time mean the pool is too small or connections are held too long.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) name:="pool.acquire" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

"resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) "span_attr:db.query.text":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: Failed spans by operation
panels.description: Business outcomes (4xx seen by a client, declined payments) are not counted.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name) count() failed

panels.title: Top failure messages
panels.description: Span status messages, e.g. "canceling statement due to lock timeout (SQLSTATE 55P03)" or "context deadline exceeded".

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name, status_message) count() failed | sort by (failed desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Latest failed spans
panels.description: Newest failed spans; expand one and use View trace (trace_id) to open the whole trace.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:payment.status":=declined | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | math round(duration/1e6, 0.1) as ms | format "<service> <name> (<ms> ms): <status_message>" as _msg | format "error" as level

panels.title: Requests by ${attribute:text}
panels.description: Server spans grouped by the selected attribute, worst first: one product, user, pod, node or version standing out points to the cause (a hot row, a bad pod or node, a bad release).

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "${attribute:raw}":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "${attribute:raw}" as value | stats by (value) count() calls, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") e5, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, max(duration) slowest | math round(e5*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_5xx | sort by (pct_5xx desc, p95 desc) | limit 30

"resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "${attribute:raw}":* "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5" | copy "${attribute:raw}" as value | stats by (value) count() failed

panels.title: Checkout outcomes (api-gateway POST /api/orders)
panels.description: What users got: 201 created, 402 payment declined, 404 unknown user or product, 5xx failures.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":=api-gateway kind:=2 name:="POST /api/orders" | copy "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as code | stats by (code) count() requests

panels.title: Payment outcomes
panels.description: Payment provider answers; declines are expected (about 10% in this demo).

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop name:="payment-provider.authorize" | copy "span_attr:payment.status" as status | stats by (status) count() payments

panels.title: Slowest requests (over ${min_duration:text})
panels.description: Server spans slower than the threshold, slowest first. Click a trace ID to show the trace below.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 duration:>${min_duration:raw} | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as code | stats by (trace_id, service, name, code) max(duration) took, max(start_time_unix_nano) started | math round(started/1e6) as started_ms | sort by (took desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Failed requests (5xx)
panels.description: Server spans answered with a 5xx, newest first. Click a trace ID to show the trace below.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=shop "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as code | stats by (trace_id, service, name, code) max(duration) took, max(start_time_unix_nano) started | math round(started/1e6) as started_ms | sort by (started_ms desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Trace: ${trace_id:text}
panels.description: The slowest or failed request of the time range by default; pick another in the Trace variable (slowest first) or click a trace ID in the tables above. Every span with its timing, attributes and links to the logs and metrics of its service.
